_comment: Phase 3 in-repo slice (docs/AUTODEV_PLATFORM_MIGRATION.md, Phase 3 'Then' -- Define AutoDev semantic attributes under an autodev.* namespace). This freezes the additive autodev.* emission mapping contract (resource-scope keys go into resource.attributes; event-scope keys go into event/span/log/datapoint attributes; output preserves all existing keys; unknown optional values produce no autodev key; no prompt or response content is ever carried). Emission is opt-in: the router-side helper in scripts/codex-model-router.mjs only enriches when AUTODEV_OTEL_ATTRIBUTES=v1. The helper is non-mutating: it returns a fresh cloned payload or the original payload untouched when nothing applies.

mappings.rule: Adds autodev.role to resource.attributes when role is known. If role is unknown, omits key.
Adds autodev.workspace to resource.attributes when workspace is known. Preserves existing workspace_id attribute. If workspace is unknown, omits key.
Adds autodev.provider to resource.attributes when provider is known. If provider is unknown, omits key.
Adds autodev.model to resource.attributes when session model is known. Preserves existing event-level model attribute. If model is unknown, omits key.
Adds autodev.spawn.mechanism to logRecord attributes for spawn events when mechanism is known. If mechanism is unknown or record is not a spawn event, omits key.
Adds autodev.skill to logRecord or metric dataPoint attributes when skill is known. Preserves existing unprefixed skill attribute. If skill is unknown, omits key.

Adds autodev.mcp.server to logRecord or span attributes when MCP server is known. Preserves existing server_name span attribute and mcp_servers resource attribute. If MCP server is unknown, omits key.

additive_full.description: Full enrichment example where resource context and event attributes are known.

unknown_optional_omitted.description: Demonstrates that unknown optional values produce no autodev.* key.
